neighbours.label: the subword token 'anie' (Stef[anie], Tanz[anie], be[anie]); also the suffix piece 'je' in South Slavic verbal nouns and 'ess' in 'wholeness'

notes: Layer 0: a token-level unit. 'ess' fired in 'wholeness' (0.67) but not in 'hostess', 'dress', 'kindness' (under 0.02), so it is the piece after 'wholen', not the suffix in general.
